title: 头脑风暴工作流
Guided brainstorming
description: 从问题定义到发散、归类、决策和验证
Define, diverge, cluster, decide and validate

title: 1 · 定义问题
1 · Define the problem
我们如何帮助谁解决什么问题？
How might we help whom solve what problem?
示例：让新用户在十分钟内完成首次记录
Example: help new users capture their first note in ten minutes
写下已有证据与待验证假设
Separate existing evidence from untested assumptions
列出时间、预算与不可改变的条件
List time, budget and fixed constraints

notes: 建议 5 分钟。先统一问题与边界，暂不讨论解决方案。
Allow 5 minutes. Agree on the problem and boundaries before proposing solutions.

title: 2 · 独立发散
2 · Diverge independently
静默写想法：每个主题只写一个
Write silently: one idea per topic
如果只能做最小的一步？
What is the smallest possible step?
借用其他行业的做法
Borrow an approach from another field

notes: 建议 8 分钟独立思考、5 分钟分享。欢迎不成熟的想法，先追求数量。
Allow 8 minutes to think and 5 to share. Welcome rough ideas and seek quantity first.

title: 3 · 聚类与补充
3 · Cluster and build
把相近想法移到同一分支
Move related ideas into a shared branch
为每组写一个清晰名称
Give each cluster a clear name
保留少数意见与离群想法
Keep minority views and outliers
组合两种想法，补出新方案
Combine two ideas into a new option

notes: 建议 8 分钟。按含义归类，不按提出者归类；合并时保留原始信息。
Allow 8 minutes. Group by meaning rather than author and retain the original intent.

title: 4 · 评估与选择
4 · Evaluate and choose
关键风险与证据强度
Key risks and strength of evidence
记录入选方案及取舍理由
Record the chosen option and tradeoffs

notes: 建议 10 分钟。评分是讨论线索，不是事实；高不确定性方案先验证。
Allow 10 minutes. Scores guide discussion rather than prove facts. Test uncertain options first.

title: 5 · 转成行动
5 · Commit to actions
示例：制作三屏原型，邀请五人试用
Example: build a three-screen prototype and invite five people to try it
截止时间与交付物：待确认
Due date and deliverable: to agree

notes: 每项行动指定一名负责人，并约定完成的具体含义。
Assign one owner to each action and agree on what completion means.

title: 6 · 验证与复盘
6 · Validate and review
收集观察，区分事实和解释
Collect observations; separate facts from interpretations
下次保留什么、改变什么？
What should we keep or change next time?

notes: 在实验开始前约定判断标准。复盘时记录结果及下一轮问题。
Agree on criteria before the experiment. At review, record the outcome and the next question.
